proof_body:
by
  intro ι E H M _ _ _ _ I _ _ _ _ _ s U hs hU hc
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := SmoothPartitionOfUnity.exists_isSubordinate I hs U hU hc
  exact ⟨f, hf, fun x hx => f.sum_eq_one hx⟩
target_source: ∀ (ι E H M : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H) [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] [IsManifold I ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) M] [T2Space M] [SigmaCompactSpace M] (s : Set M) (U : ι → Set M), IsClosed s → (∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) → s ⊆ ⋃ i, U i → ∃ f : SmoothPartitionOfUnity ι I M s, f.IsSubordinate U ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, ∑ᶠ i, f i x = 1
